summary: The diff implements most of the required payment gate features. Backend adds ownerIcpAddress in stable state, getIcpAddress/setIcpAddress/confirmActivation/isUserActivated functions, and a migration module. Frontend adds PaymentGate component, useActivationQueries hooks, App.tsx integration, and i18n translations. However, there are notable gaps: the backend function is named 'confirmActivation' instead of the spec-required 'activateUser', the backend query is named 'isUserActivated' instead of the spec-required 'isActivated', and existing authenticated data endpoints do not enforce the activation gate.

missing_requirements.requirement: An update function `activateUser(principal)` can be called only by the canister owner to activate a user.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend implements `confirmActivation(user)` instead of the spec-required `activateUser(principal)`. The function name differs from the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: A query function `isActivated(principal)` returns whether the user is activated.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend implements `isUserActivated(user)` instead of the spec-required `isActivated(principal)`. The function name differs from the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: All existing authenticated endpoints respect the activation gate: non-activated users receive an appropriate error.
missing_requirements.reason: No changes to existing data endpoints (profile, nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting) are visible in the diff to check activation status before serving data. The gate is only enforced at the frontend App.tsx level.

hallucinated_features.description: A dedicated migration module (backend/migration.mo) for stable state schema upgrades
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec does not request a migration module; it only requires storing new fields in stable state. The migration.mo file was added without being explicitly requested.
